profile.headline: Software Engineer at Rokt
profile.summary:
Engineer specializing in cross-platform systems, owning the design and delivery of mobile, backend, and cloud solutions.

Proven experience building and scaling SDKs and applications across Android, iOS, React Native, and Flutter, alongside backend services and distributed systems.

Currently focused on system architecture and applying AI-driven approaches to orchestrate development workflows, improve decision-making, and accelerate delivery.

Combines deep systems knowledge (C/C++, Linux) with modern application development to build high-performance, scalable platforms.

Experienced in CI/CD, release processes, and end-to-end system ownership.
